info.name: Product Inventory API (Layered Architecture)
info.description:
Tests for every endpoint of the Product Inventory API, including failure cases (marked with ❌).

HOW TO RUN
1. Start the API:  npm run dev  (it runs at http://localhost:3000)
2. Import this file into Postman.
3. IMPORTANT: restart the server before each full run. The data is kept in memory, so a restart resets it to the starting data these tests expect.
4. Click the collection > Run, keep the folder order, and press Run. Every test should pass.

The folders are meant to run in order: later requests use ids saved by earlier ones (newCategoryId, newProductId, waterQty).
Change the baseUrl collection variable if your server uses another port.

request.description: Open this first. If it fails, the server is not running (npm run dev).

exec: pm.test('data is a list with at least 3 categories', function () { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(d.length).to.be.at.least(3); });
pm.test('starting data includes Drinks', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.map(function (c) { return c.name; })).to.include('Drinks'); });
pm.test('it is Drinks', function () { const c = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(c.id).to.eql(1); pm.expect(c.name).to.eql('Drinks'); });
pm.test('name was saved and an id was given', function () { const c = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(c.name).to.eql('Toiletries'); pm.expect(c.id).to.be.a('number'); });

exec: pm.test('list has at least 6 products', function () { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(d.length).to.be.at.least(6); });
pm.test('every product has a true/false lowStock field', function () { pm.response.json().data.forEach(function (p) { pm.expect(p.lowStock).to.be.a('boolean'); }); });

pm.test('only products from category 1 come back', function () { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.length).to.be.at.least(2); d.forEach(function (p) { pm.expect(p.categoryId).to.eql(1); }); });
pm.test('Bottled Water is found', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.map(function (p) { return p.name; })).to.include('Bottled Water'); });
pm.test('it is Bottled Water with a lowStock field', function () { const p = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(p.name).to.eql('Bottled Water'); pm.expect(p.lowStock).to.be.a('boolean'); });

pm.test('product was saved correctly', function () { const p = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(p.name).to.eql('Hand Soap'); pm.expect(p.quantity).to.eql(30); pm.expect(p.categoryId).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('newCategoryId'))); });
pm.test('lowStock is false (30 is above the threshold of 8)', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.lowStock).to.eql(false); });

item.name: Check Bottled Water stock before selling

request.description: Saves the current quantity so the next requests can check the maths.

exec: pm.test('quantity went down by exactly 3', function () { const q = pm.response.json().data.quantity; pm.expect(q).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('waterQty')) - 3); pm.collectionVariables.set('waterQty', q); });
pm.test('response has a lowStock field', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.lowStock).to.be.a('boolean'); });

pm.test('quantity went up by exactly 20', function () { const q = pm.response.json().data.quantity; pm.expect(q).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('waterQty')) + 20); pm.collectionVariables.set('waterQty', q); });

item.name: Try to sell far more than we have (change = -500)

exec: pm.test('message says there is not enough stock', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include('Not enough stock'); });

item.name: Stock is unchanged after the failed sale

exec: pm.test('quantity is the same as before the failed sale', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.quantity).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('waterQty'))); });

request.description: A rejected sale must not change any data.
